usage.description: DesignSprintsSection is the homepage band promoting design sprints, with animated CTA pills. It is copy-complete via i18n and takes only anchor wiring (id, donnyTarget) plus className. It composes with the other homepage bands (HomeHero, ServicesSection, WorkMagneticField, CTASection); it is not a generic reusable band, so for configurable content use HighlightSection or CTASection.
